title: Minimum Additions To Make Valid String
description:
A valid string is one or more concatenated copies of `"abc"`. Given a string `word` containing only `a`, `b`, and `c`, return the minimum number of characters to insert so it becomes valid.

## Examples

```text
Input: word = "b"
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: word = "abc"
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= word.length <= 50`
- `word` contains only `a`, `b`, and `c`
